description: This file defines the MachineName class, a Drupal render element for handling machine-readable name input fields with validation, processing, and transliteration support.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Render\Element\MachineName
classes.description: A Drupal render element class for machine name input fields, extending Textfield, with methods for processing, validation, and transliteration.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns default properties for the machine name form element, including processing and validation callbacks.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Processes the input value for the machine name element, ensuring it is a scalar string or null.

methods.name: processMachineName
methods.description: Prepares the machine name form element, setting defaults, handling source element linkage, and attaching necessary libraries and settings.

methods.name: validateMachineName
methods.description: Validates the machine name input for disallowed characters, uniqueness, and proper formatting.

methods.name: getTransliterationLanguageOverrides
methods.description: Retrieves language-specific transliteration overrides, loading from a file and allowing module alterations.
